_comment: restore-snapshot: replay a captured authored-content snapshot onto this catalog. DRAFT-SAFE — writes go through update_exercise (document service), never publish, review_status forced unreviewed; a clinician still approves in Review & publish. 'snapshot' is a path to the snapshot json (absolute, or relative to this job folder); produce one with scripts/capture_snapshot.py or use the repo's scripts/migrations/data/authored-content.json. Records match this catalog by carespaceId; relations resolve by name (a name absent from this catalog's canonical vocab is skipped + reported, never invented); missing equipment terms are created. Idempotent: a draft already carrying movement_complexity is skipped unless force=true.
